race.description: Tim & Janice Ball Greentree Ngaliya Civil & Fencing Hcp (C3)
race.comment: CALATHINITE (1) finished seventh two runs back at Port Hedland then improved last time out to score by 0.6 lengths as favourite over 1200m at Port Hedland. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot repeat the dose. LADY COCO (6) showed good early speed and raced on the pace last start before fading to finish eighth, beaten 4 lengths, over 1400m at Pinjarra. Sure to give a great sight. IF I DIN HAVADIME (9) was below her best last time, finishing eighth over 1300m at Port Hedland after being in contention on the bend. Has her share of ability. Hard to beat in this suitable race. TORQUED UP (3) was beaten 6 lengths into sixth over 1200m at Marble Bar at his latest appearance. Better than recent efforts suggest. DAWN RETREAT (8) is better than he showed last time out and his best form is good enough.
